surgido: to arise, emerge, surface, crop up, spring up, pop up
to grow out of, to come from, arise from (followed by de)
imites: to imitate, to mimic, to ape, to copy, to copycat, to impersonate…
dañen: to damage, to harm, to hurt, to injure
enjugará: to wipe, wipe off, wipe down
lamentándose: to mourn (often followed by la muerte de or la pérdida de)
